opportunities.name: Track a Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: On us.megabus, open Check my bus > Track my bus, search by a given service number (and pick the stop if asked), then find the bus.
steps: Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'
If asked, pick the stop/city from the suggestions

opportunities.description: On Resy, open a special event listing, choose a ticket count (and time slot), then go through Book/Reserve Now to confirm.
steps: Open the Special Events & Experiences venues list
Click the event listing you want
Choose the number of tickets in the ticket dropdown
Pick a time slot or click 'Book Now'
Click 'Reserve Now' and continue with 'NEXT' to confirm
